findings.text: the assertion sum(callers.values()) == reads.total() cannot fail, because the counted stand-in increments reads at line 117 and callers at line 125 in one body, so the accounted total is a property of the instrument and the census cannot report a mis-attributed read.

the snapshot branch returns the raw live row and so skips the station-pid strip in runs.read_pointer at reckon/crew/runs.py:1575-1589, so a scoped read of a station-launched review carries a pid the standalone reader drops; it is latent today because recovery_classification.py:876-881 reads only the phase and launch stamps.

the held-snapshot-else-list policy is copied into nine readers rather than owned by reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:36-64, so a future reader that omits the fallback silently loses the sharing while still passing its own tests.
